description: Needs sign-in: List the person's documents that they own, most recent first (at most 100; "truncated": true when there are more). Each entry has the document's id (pass it as documentId to read_document or to the compute tools), its title, its kind (notebook or plot) and the time of its last change (ISO 8601). Folders, archived documents and documents in the trash are not listed.
name: list_documents
title: List my documents
